The '''Republic Concourse''' was the western region of the [[Mercantile Plaza]], a trading platform constructed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] by the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]]. It was the only part of the plaza where [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] individuals were permitted, while the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] used the [[Imperial Concourse]].
